Chapter 6425: Begging

Chapter 6425: Begging

Virtuoso and his allies were at a loss for words after seeing emperors and desolate gods run with wanton regard for their dignity and reputation.

Heavenly Crane nearly vomited blood from anger. Today, two lesser villains betrayed him while the others fled.

“So soon to leave?” Just when the group was ten million miles away and thought they were safe, they heard Li Qiye’s voice in their ears.

He casually threw the pot toward the horizon, forming a perfect arc.

“Bam! Bam! Bam!” Nine-cries, Ghost-sparrow, and Ravenous Wolf God summoned their treasures but it was futile.

The pot perfectly struck them back to the scene, drilling into the ground and making pits in front of Li Qiye.

“Was I a bad host?” Li Qiye took a sip of tea.

Everyone watched with bated breath since this supreme ancestor of Desolate Frontier was at an unimaginable level.

Nine-cries, Ghost-sparrow, and Ravenous Wolf God climbed up with a pale expression. The guy before them might be more than a primal ancestor, potentially a supreme overlord.

Ravenous Wolf God reacted faster than the other two, lowering his head to speak: “We have offended you, Sir, please forgive us.”

“You said you want to feast earlier, right?” Li Qiye asked.

“We lived under another person’s roof and had to obey his orders, it wasn’t our intention.” Ravenous Wolf God responded.

Others had nothing but contempt for this coward of a desolate god.

“Is that so?” Li Qiye smiled and turned toward Heavenly Crane.

“You will die.” Heavenly Crane snorted and told Ravenous Wolf God instead.

His primal aura made them shake in horror.

“You think you will fare better than us today? You will die as well.” Nine-cries retorted.

These villains had not an ounce of comradery. They merely banded together for survival.

“Sir, we were forced to join Isles of Evil, commanded to commit heinous acts.” Nine-cries told Li Qiye.

Heavenly Crane was furious because these villains were always subservient. Now, they placed all the blame on him.

“I don’t know if it was forced, but I did hear you say you wanted to eat me.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Well...” Nine-cries had an awkward expression: “I was blind and didn’t know you were an immortal. Please, forgive us insects.”

“You all have completely disgraced your title, there is no shred of dignity or pride.” Li Qiye couldn’t help but shake his head: “Why? Perhaps becoming emperors and desolate gods is too easy in this world, even random dogs and cats can reach this level so there’s no prestige.”

Virtuoso and the others felt a bit embarrassed after being caught in the criticism as well. They spent immense effort and worked tirelessly to reach this realm. It wasn’t as easy as he made it out to be.

“Insects like us can’t compare to you, Immortal.” Ravenous Wolf God only wanted to survive.

“Then you will have the fate of an insect.” Li Qiye smiled and said: “Today is Ocean-gaze’s birthday, so I will fry the three of you for him since he couldn’t eat his longevity noodles. That’s not a bad appetizer.”

The trio staggered backward.

“Screw it, die!” The quiet Ghost-sparrow finally shouted; the only one who didn’t beg for mercy.

He opened his eyes and spewed out flames of desire.

“Eternal Sorrow!” He roared and his power reached all planes of reality.

He screamed in pain as he ignited ablaze, burning his past, present, and future.

After a split second, the flames condensed and surged toward Li Qiye. His goal was to take Li Qiye down with him.

“Go!” Nine-cries and Ravenous Wolf God attacked at the same time.

“Soulcaller!” Nine-cries summoned an iron scythe and roared.

It fixated on one’s true fate and soul, wanting to rip them from the body.

“Star Devour!” Ravenous Wolf God tried to swallow Li Qiye.

Stars turned into a bloody jaw looming above Imperial League.

They hoped this ambush would at least do something to him.

“Nonsense.” Li Qiye didn’t bat an eye while swinging the pot, crushing all three moves.
